project.title: Omnichannel Customer Service Playbook for Retail Contact Centre
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified customer service playbook for store, bookshop, and contact centre teams to improve consistency and first-contact resolution.
deliverables: Omnichannel customer service playbook covering phone, chat, and in-store interactions
Standard call handling and escalation workflows for the contact centre
Bookshop-specific customer guidance and recommendation guidelines
Sales and cross-sell conversation scripts for specialised sellers
Quality monitoring and coaching framework for supervisors
Training rollout plan and feedback summary from pilot teams
constraints: Playbook must be usable by both contact centre and in-store specialised sellers
All procedures must comply with consumer protection and data privacy regulations
Initial version must be ready for pilot within 21 days
Documentation must be simple enough for new hires to apply after 1 day of training
Changes must not require modifications to existing e-commerce systems
Quality metrics must be measurable using current reporting tools

risks.risk: Playbook is too complex and agents or sellers do not adopt it consistently.
risks.mitigation: Run a small pilot, collect feedback, simplify wording, and add quick-reference checklists.

risks.risk: Guidelines conflict with existing legal or compliance requirements.
risks.mitigation: Have compliance review all customer-facing scripts and escalation rules before rollout.

risks.risk: In-store and contact centre teams have different expectations and resist a unified approach.
risks.mitigation: Include representatives from both areas in design workshops and highlight local adaptations.

risks.risk: No measurable impact on customer satisfaction or first-contact resolution.
risks.mitigation: Define baseline metrics, set clear targets, and adjust scripts and workflows after first month of data.

themes.theme: Standardising call and in-store interaction flows
themes.why_relevant: Ensures customers receive consistent service regardless of channel or location.
Supervisors need clear criteria and tools to coach agents and sellers effectively.

themes.theme: Sales and cross-sell in support conversations
themes.why_relevant: Specialised sellers must balance solving issues with relevant product recommendations.
Bookshop sellers need tailored scripts for recommendations and special orders.

themes.theme: Compliance and data privacy in conversations
themes.why_relevant: All scripts must respect legal requirements when handling customer data.
Pilot feedback is needed to refine the playbook before full deployment.

backlog.task: Map current contact centre call types and escalation paths
definition_of_done: Top 10 call types identified with volumes and pain points
Current escalation rules documented for each call type
Gaps and inconsistencies between supervisors noted in a summary

backlog.task: Draft standard call opening, verification, and closing scripts
definition_of_done: Scripts for greeting, verification, and closing written for phone and chat
Scripts reviewed by at least one contact centre supervisor
Compliance feedback incorporated and version 1.0 stored in shared doc

backlog.task: Design quality monitoring scorecard for calls and chats
definition_of_done: Scorecard criteria defined for soft skills, compliance, and resolution
Scoring rubric created with examples of good and bad behaviours
Scorecard template shared and approved by project stakeholders

backlog.task: Create in-store specialised seller sales and cross-sell scripts
definition_of_done: Scripts for at least 5 common customer scenarios drafted
Cross-sell prompts aligned with current product catalogue
Scripts validated by contact centre supervisor for tone consistency

backlog.task: Develop bookshop recommendation and special order guidelines
definition_of_done: Checklist for understanding customer reading preferences created
Process for handling special publication orders documented
Examples of 10 recommendation dialogues added to guideline

backlog.task: Align omnichannel service principles across store and contact centre
definition_of_done: List of shared service principles agreed by all roles
Differences between channels documented with rationale
Principles integrated into the main playbook document

backlog.task: Compile the omnichannel customer service playbook v1.0
definition_of_done: All approved scripts, workflows, and guidelines consolidated
Table of contents and quick-reference sections added
Playbook shared with stakeholders for final comments

backlog.task: Design quick-reference checklists for agents and sellers
definition_of_done: One-page checklist for call handling created
One-page checklist for in-store interactions created
Both checklists tested with at least 2 colleagues and refined

backlog.task: Plan and schedule pilot training sessions
definition_of_done: Target pilot teams identified in contact centre and stores
Training agenda and materials list documented
Training dates confirmed and calendar invites sent

backlog.task: Collect and summarise pilot feedback from teams
definition_of_done: Feedback form or template agreed and shared
At least 10 pieces of feedback collected from different roles
Key themes and improvement suggestions summarised in a short report

backlog.task: Review playbook for legal and data privacy compliance
definition_of_done: All scripts and workflows checked against compliance checklist
Any non-compliant phrasing updated or removed
Compliance sign-off recorded in project documentation

backlog.task: Define success metrics and reporting approach for rollout
definition_of_done: Baseline metrics for satisfaction and resolution documented
Target improvements for first 3 months agreed
Simple reporting schedule and owners defined

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, success metrics, and initial call type mapping for the playbook.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for input on top customer scenarios.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final list of top 10 call and in-store interaction types to prioritise.
Confirm the initial success metrics and baseline data sources for the project.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and iterate on standard call handling and quality monitoring approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Supervisor shares first draft of call scripts and scorecard for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve version 1.0 of standard call opening, verification, and closing scripts.
Agree on the final quality monitoring scorecard criteria and scoring rules.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define in-store specialised seller and bookshop-specific guidelines.
threads_plan.trigger: Specialised seller posts initial sales and cross-sell scripts for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the core sales and cross-sell scripts for specialised sellers.
Approve the bookshop recommendation and special order guidelines.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Consolidate the omnichannel playbook and align on shared principles.
threads_plan.trigger: Supervisor shares draft table of contents and asks for gaps and overlaps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final set of omnichannel service principles to include in the playbook.
Sign off on playbook v1.0 content for pilot rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan pilot training, collect feedback, and define next iteration.
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement of pilot schedule and request for volunteers and feedback expectations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot scope, participating teams, and training dates.
Agree on which improvements from pilot feedback will go into playbook v1.1.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday progress, today focus, and blockers.
Twice-weekly review of new scripts or guidelines with 24-hour async comment window.
Weekly summary post from a contact centre supervisor capturing decisions and next steps.
Pilot phase feedback roundup after each training session with key insights and actions.
End-of-project retrospective thread focusing on what to keep, change, and drop for next rollout.
